business_summary.text: LTM is an AI-centric global technology services company and Business Creativity partner to large enterprises, with over 87,000 employees across 40 countries.

call_points.text: Order inflow of USD 1.3 billion was mostly short-tenure AI-led deals; management will consider disclosing ACV after one more quarter.
call_points.versus_prior: new: no ACV split disclosed yet

call_points.text: BFSI returned to year-on-year growth at 0.4% and grew 3.1% sequentially.
Tech and services fell 4% sequentially on a seasonal renewal cycle plus the Saudi business impact.
Payout ratio rose from around 40% to around 45% last year; reinvestment in M&A and AI continues.
AI projects carry better gross margins than traditional services, with some investment ploughed back.
Saudi business cost about 0.6-0.7% of quarterly growth; management sees demand elsewhere.
Traditional large deals face pricing pressure; AI rate cards are priced higher than traditional ones.
Proposed acquisition of Randstad's tech and consulting business in Europe and Australia for €160 million EV.
Total order inflow for FY2026 stood at USD 6.6 billion, representing a 10.3% increase year-over-year.
FY2026 operating margins stood at 15.4%, reflecting a 90 bps improvement on a year-over-year basis.

operating_notes.text: Total active clients reached 751 as of March 31, 2026.
Total headcount stood at 87,950 at the end of FY2026, with a net addition of 3,643 employees year-over-year.
LTM partnered with Uniphore to power its BlueVerse ecosystem using Uniphore's Business AI Cloud for enterprise workflows.
Total number of permanent employees on the rolls of the company as on March 31, 2026 stood at 87,950.
LTM launched the LTM Business Orchestration Platform utilizing BlueVerse as a marketplace layer for SAP-focused AI agents.
LTM launched BlueVerse M.A.X, an AI Marketing Assist solution built on Agentforce Marketing by Salesforce.
LTM won the Golden Peacock Award for Excellence in AI 2026, a new category introduced in 2026
LTM issued an offer to acquire Randstad's Technology and Consulting Services business in Europe and Australia with an enterprise valuation of up to EUR 160 million.
Proposed acquisition of Randstad's technology and consulting services business in Europe and Australia with USD 500M+ in annual revenue at an enterprise value of €160M.
LTM entered a strategic partnership with UK-based SSP Group to drive AI-powered IT infrastructure modernization and application support.
LTM proposed acquiring Randstad's Technology and Consulting Services business in Europe and Australia for an enterprise value of €160 million.
Lakshya 2031 plan aims for ~2X revenue and ~200 bps EBIT margin expansion over FY26.
LTM launched its Managed Secure Service Edge solution built on Cisco Secure Access at Cisco Live 2026.
AI revenue across Creative, Industrial and Business AI contributed about USD 150 million on a quarterly run-rate basis.
Order book steady at USD 1.7 billion including two large deal wins; new deals priced roughly 15% lower than a year ago on AI productivity.
Middle East is less than 3% of revenue; headcount 87,886 with 1,308 freshers added and TTM attrition at 13.3%.
Order book stable at USD 1.7 billion including two large deal wins; management said FY27 order book carries about 15% AI deflation versus FY26 pricing.
AI revenue across Creative, Industrial and Business AI was about USD 150 million quarterly run rate; Business AI is the largest piece, followed by Industrial AI and Creative AI.
Utilisation excluding trainees was 86.4% versus 85.7% in Q4; headcount 87,886 with 1,308 freshers added.
LTM partnered with Glean, pairing Glean's enterprise knowledge graph and search/agents with LTM's BlueVerse agentic AI ecosystem for IT support, knowledge management and application operations.
LTM partnered with Chainguard, combining Chainguard's open-source security expertise with LTM's BlueVerse RightLogic framework to enhance software supply chain security for AI-enabled development.

Works Council information-consultation for the Randstad Digital BV, Randstad Digital France and FINXL acquisition completed; SPA signed by LTM UK & Ireland Limited, completion subject to regulatory approvals.
LTM collaborated with IBM and Red Hat on Lightwell to advance AI-driven open-source software remediation
LTM launched BlueVerse SovereignSphere Models on September 23, 2026 with offerings in Sales and Marketing Pro, Contract Pro, and FinCast
BlueVerse OneToken launched with a time-bound immersion program for global clients to benchmark AI token consumption; no pricing or revenue target disclosed.
LTM's clients PHINIA and Carrier recognized with ISG Paragon Awards North America 2026 for transformation delivered with LTM

BlueVerse AgenTraceIQ launched with Rubrik Agent Cloud under Project Hourglass, supporting Microsoft Copilot Studio, Salesforce Agentforce, Amazon Bedrock and Anthropic Claude; no pricing or revenue target disclosed.
LTM announced expanded collaboration with Google Cloud to accelerate Gemini Enterprise adoption at scale, including dedicated CoE and Customer Experience Center

LTM won a multi-million-dollar, three-year managed services deal with a North American specialty engineering and construction company, consolidating infrastructure, cybersecurity and application administration work from multiple providers;

Secured a 3-year multi-million-dollar deal consolidating infrastructure, cybersecurity and application administration managed services for a North American specialty engineering and construction company.
Q2FY27 order inflow was $1.26 Bn, down 30 bps YoY; TTM order inflow $6.32 Bn.
Utilisation excluding trainees was 86.4% and total employees 88,835 in Q2FY27.
Enterprise AI and Business AI revenue together grew 47% YoY in Q2FY27.
Launched BlueVerse ValueMesh, an AI execution fabric for Oracle transformations.
AI revenue reached 13.4% of overall revenue in Q2FY27, growing 40% year-over-year.
Order inflow stood at USD 1.3 billion in Q2FY27, mostly short-tenure AI-led deals.
Total DSO improved by 1 day to 84 days from 85 days last quarter.
Launched BlueVerse Industrial AI Lab in Chennai combining vision AI, robotics, digital twins, and embedded device engineering.
Secured a strategic 2-year engagement (with 1-year extension option) with a large global banking and financial services firm with potential value up to USD 100 million.
Launched GCC Origin on 28 Oct 2026, an independently operated unit led by Shailendra Singh targeting next-gen AI-native Global Capability Centers.

timeline.summary: LTM announced winning two Google Cloud Partner of the Year Awards for 2026 on April 22, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹11,291.7 Cr (+15.6% YoY), net profit ₹1,387.3 Cr (+22.9% YoY).
LTM Limited’s Board recommended a final dividend of ₹53 per equity share for FY2026, pending AGM approval.
LTM Limited’s **Angna Arora** shared Q4FY-26 earnings conference call recording on April 23, 2026, available at [link](https://www.ltm.com/investors/financial-results/).
LTM launched BlueVerse Studio in Bengaluru as a hub for Enterprise Agentic AI adoption on April 28, 2026.
LTM Limited reported Q4FY26 revenue of $1.22 billion (up 8.1% YoY) and FY2026 PAT of ₹4,983 Cr, while announcing a final dividend of ₹53 per share.
LTM was recognized as a Market Leader in HFS Horizons Next-gen IT Infrastructure Services 2026 Report.
LTM Limited’s 30th AGM scheduled for June 1, 2026, at 11:00 AM (IST) via video conference, with Record Date for FY-26 final dividend set for May 25, 2026.
LTM partnered with Uniphore to integrate its Business AI Cloud with LTM's BlueVerse ecosystem for domain-specific AI solutions.
LTM Limited submitted its Integrated Annual Report for FY26, reporting consolidated revenue of ₹42,308 Cr and a clean audit opinion.
LTM launched the LTM Business Orchestration Platform, an AI-powered offering integrating with SAP environments via its BlueVerse ecosystem.
LTM launched BlueVerse M.A.X, an AI marketing orchestration solution built on Salesforce.
2026-05-15: LTM wins Golden Peacock Award for Excellence in AI
2026-05-20: LTM named a Leader in ISG Provider Lens® SAP Ecosystem 2026 report for SAP Business AI capabilities.
LTM announced a put option deed through its UK subsidiary to acquire Randstad's technology and consulting services business in Europe and Australia for up to €160M.
LTM submitted an investor presentation detailing the proposed acquisition of Randstad's technology and consulting services business in Europe and Australia for an enterprise value of €160M.
LTM Limited shared the audio recording of its May 22, 2026, investor call at 12:30 p.m. IST on its website.
LTM announced a strategic partnership with UK-based SSP Group on May 25, 2026, to drive AI-powered IT infrastructure and application support modernization.
LTM hosted an investor call on May 22, 2026, detailing the proposed acquisition of Randstad's technology and consulting services business in Europe and Australia.
LTM launched its Managed Secure Service Edge (SSE) solution built on Cisco Secure Access at Cisco Live 2026.
LTM submitted applications to BSE and NSE for reclassification of Nabha Power from promoter to public category
LTM's Q1FY27 call flagged EBIT margin at 15.5% (+120 bps YoY), PAT of ₹1,469 Cr, and guided organic growth to accelerate from Q2 with the Randstad acquisition closing around early Q3.
LTM held its Q1FY27 earnings call on July 11, 2026, reporting 18% YoY INR revenue growth to ₹11,608 Cr, 15.5% EBIT margin and ₹1,469 Cr PAT, and said organic growth should accelerate from Q2.
LTM announced a strategic partnership with enterprise AI platform Glean on 17 July 2026, combining Glean's enterprise context layer with LTM's BlueVerse agentic AI ecosystem.
LTM announced a strategic partnership with Cognition to launch BlueVerse RightLogic with Devin for cyber risk reduction in financial services.
LTM announced a strategic collaboration with Chainguard to strengthen software supply chain security through BlueVerse™ RightLogic on August 6, 2026.

On 22 August 2026, LTM said its UK arm signed the SPA to buy all shares in Randstad Digital B.V., Randstad Digital France SAS and FINXL Professional Services Pty Ltd, with completion subject to regulatory approvals.
LTM received NSE and BSE no-objection letters on September 4, 2026 for reclassifying Nabha Power Limited from promoter group to public category.
On September 9, 2026, LTM announced a collaboration with IBM and Red Hat on Lightwell for AI-driven open-source software remediation.
On 21 September 2026, LTM announced Shekhar Kapur as Strategic Advisor to its BlueVerse Craft business unit for AI-powered storytelling.
On 2026-09-23, LTM launched BlueVerse SovereignSphere Models to help enterprises own their AI advantage

2026-09-24: LTM launched BlueVerse OneToken, a workload routing and governance layer that routes enterprise AI requests to the most cost-appropriate model via a single subscription across AWS, Google Cloud and Azure.
On 2026-09-30, LTM announced that its clients PHINIA and Carrier were recognized with ISG Paragon Awards North America 2026 for transformation delivered with LTM.
On 2026-10-05, LTM launched BlueVerse AgenTraceIQ, an agentic-AI governance and resilience offering built on Rubrik Agent Cloud under Rubrik's Project Hourglass.
2026-10-07: LTM expands collaboration with Google Cloud to accelerate Gemini Enterprise adoption at scale
Board of Directors under **Anish AngnaDate: Anish Arora** may declare interim dividend on ₹1 face-value equity shares, with record date October 23, 2026.

2026-10-15: LTM announced a multi-million-dollar, three-year managed services agreement with a North American specialty engineering and construction company, consolidating infrastructure, cybersecurity and application services from multiple providers.
LTM secured a 3-year multi-million-dollar AI-led managed services contract with a North American specialty engineering and construction firm.

2026-10-16: LTM reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹11,808 Cr (+13.6% YoY) and PAT of ₹1,380 Cr (flat YoY), declared a ₹25 interim dividend and appointed Anupam Kumar as Non-Executive Non-Independent Director.
LTM Limited’s Q2FY27 earnings conference call recording, held on October 16, 2026, is available via the company’s website.
LTM launched BlueVerse ValueMesh to help enterprises scale AI across Oracle transformations.
On October 16, 2026, LTM reported that AI revenue reached 13.4% of total sales in Q2FY27 and management guided for stronger sequential growth in H2.
LTM launched the BlueVerse Industrial AI Lab in Chennai to co-innovate and scale AI solutions for physical operations and intelligent products.
LTM secured a 2-year strategic engagement worth up to USD 100 million with a large global banking and financial services firm as a preferred supplier consolidation partner.
LTM launched GCC Origin, a standalone business unit led by Shailendra Singh to deliver AI-native Global Capability Center services.
